option.soundvisualizer.enabled.tooltip: Show sound indicators. Can also be toggled with a key (Controls > Sound Visualizer).
option.soundvisualizer.preset.tooltip: Pick a look and press Save. A preset overrides the style, radius, thickness, span, glow, fade, ripple and icon settings.
option.soundvisualizer.indicatorStyle.to:
Arc: smooth tapered line
Dashed: segmented line
Chevron: arc with an outward pointer
option.soundvisualizer.radius.tooltip: Distance of the indicators from the crosshair.
option.soundvisualizer.lineThickness.too: Width of the arc line at its centre.
option.soundvisualizer.arcSpan.tooltip: How many degrees of the circle each indicator covers.
option.soundvisualizer.glowIntensity.too: Strength of the soft bloom around the arc. 0% disables it.
option.soundvisualizer.fadeTime.tooltip: How long an indicator stays visible after the last sound. Pauses with the game.
option.soundvisualizer.showRipples.toolt: A faint echo expands outward when a source makes another sound.
option.soundvisualizer.showIcons.tooltip: Show the category icon in the middle of each arc.
option.soundvisualizer.iconBackdrop.tool: Soft dark disc behind icons so they stay readable on bright backgrounds.
option.soundvisualizer.tintIcons.tooltip: Colour icons with their category colour instead of white.
option.soundvisualizer.maxHearingDistanc: Sounds further away than this are ignored.
option.soundvisualizer.hideOwnSounds.too: Ignore your own footsteps, swings, eating and armor sounds.
option.soundvisualizer.mergeAngle.toolti: Sounds of the same category closer than this angle share one indicator. 0 = never merge by angle.
option.soundvisualizer.stackSounds.toolt: Combines nearby sounds of different categories into one multi-color gradient arc with stacked icons to reduce HUD clutter.
option.soundvisualizer.stackAngle.toolti: Maximum angle between different sound categories to stack them into one peripheral arc.
option.soundvisualizer.splitOnLook.toolt: Stacked indicators smoothly split into separate arrows with exact directions as you turn toward them.
option.soundvisualizer.distanceScaling.t: Nearby sounds are drawn thicker and longer than distant ones.
option.soundvisualizer.smoothTracking.to: Indicators glide when you turn instead of snapping.
option.soundvisualizer.smoothingSpeed.to: Higher = indicators follow your view faster.
option.soundvisualizer.whitelist.tooltip:
If not empty, only matching sounds are shown.
Accepts full ids (minecraft:entity.zombie.ambient), parts (zombie) or wildcards (entity.*.step).
option.soundvisualizer.blacklist.tooltip:
Matching sounds are never shown.
Accepts full ids, parts or wildcards (block.*.place).
